votes.refutation: I checked the operation's routing semantics and whether the custom team manager pins the reader. It does not. The claim treats every SELECT as db_for_read, but Django routes select_for_update through db_for_write; the subsequent update is also routed to the writer. Consequently the read-replica rejection premise is false, and adding using(run_write_db) here would duplicate existing routing rather than repair a reachable defect. Ordinary unlocked reads need explicit writer pinning, but this helper is already a locking/write queryset.
